description: This file contains multiple internal grain classes for testing activation and deactivation behaviors within an Orleans-based project. It includes grains that test normal activation/deactivation, long-running processes, error conditions, and grain reference creation.

classes.name: SimpleActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: An internal grain class that tests standard activate/deactivate lifecycle with assertions and logging.

classes.name: TailCallActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: A grain that tests activation/deactivation with asynchronous continuation and tail call semantics.

classes.name: LongRunningActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: A grain that performs long-running activation with thread sleep and task-based sub-tasks, verifying thread context.

classes.name: TaskActionActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: A grain testing activation/deactivation with complex task creation, continuation, delays, and assertions.

classes.name: BadActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: A test grain that throws exceptions during activation/deactivation to test error handling.

classes.name: BadConstructorTestGrain
classes.description: A grain with a constructor that throws an exception, used to test grain creation failure.

classes.name: DeactivatingWhileActivatingTestGrain
classes.description: A grain that deactivates itself during activation to test race conditions and lifecycle handling.

classes.name: CreateGrainReferenceTestGrain
classes.description: A grain that creates references to other grains and performs method calls, including forwarding.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the Orleans method to handle logic upon activation, with varying implementations to test behaviors.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the Orleans method to handle deactivation logic, with some grains intentionally throwing exceptions.

methods.name: DoSomething
methods.description: Returns a hash code string representing the grain's identity.

methods.name: ThrowSomething
methods.description: Throws an exception to simulate failure.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Returns the primary key or throws exception if an error is simulated.

methods.name: ForwardCall
methods.description: Calls another grain's method, forwarding the invocation.
